_comment_resume_folder: Path to watch for new PDF resumes (relative to lumina_screen/ dir)
_comment_poll_interval: How often (ms) to scan the folder for new files
_comment_threshold: Cosine-similarity threshold (0–1). Higher = stricter matching. Default 0.25 is generous
_comment_chroma: Where ChromaDB persists embeddings and collection data
_comment_jd_path: Path to the Job Description text file used for scoring
_comment_page_hit_path: Append-only log of shortlisted candidates (parsed by ui/api-server.js for display)
